title: Members
purpose: Invite people, change roles and remove access without misdrawing invitations or breaking ownership.
useWhen: A workspace or account has members with roles, invitations and removal.
avoidWhen: Sharing a single document with a link; use that product's sharing dialog instead.
alternatives: Use the settings contract for workspace preferences, and the consequential-action contract for a single removal outside a members list.
requiredInputs: the acting person's identity and permissions
an invite adapter with a result per address
a sentence per role saying what it can do
transitions: invite-sending → invitation-settled per sent address, with the result said
ready → role-pending on a role change
role-pending → role-committed, or role-failed with the role restored
applicability: Workspaces or accounts whose members have roles, invitations and removal.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; products without invitations skip those states.
